newsitem.title: USA: American Medserve sees revenue growth.
newsitem.headline: American Medserve sees revenue growth.

text.p: American Medserve Corp expects add more than $17 million to its annual revenues as a result of its investments in companies in Maryland, Pennsylvania and Virginia this year, President Timothy Burfield said on Wednesday.
The company is an independent provider of pharmaceutical care to about 46,500 residents at more than 600 long-term care and assisted living facilities in 10 states.
Earlier Wednesday, it reported a fourth-quarter loss of $0.13 per share, compared with a profit of $0.03 in the same period the previous year. Revenues rose to $27.6 million from $14.5 million.

The most recent results include non-cash, non-recurring charges of $1.8 million related to the sale of common stock to the company's officers and directors prior to the initial public offering in December 1996.
